description: Road Segment Data from Data.NSW is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. There have been a number of requests for "State Roads" data. This data is currently available via the Data.NSW Spatial Collaboration Portal. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Data-NSW, Portal, RoadSegment, Segment, State Roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
